thread:
Jules: Hey team — small but annoying one. The pricing experiment (surcharge A/B) accidentally applied to invoices for EEA customers between 2024-08-01 and 2024-08-09. We have ~82 invoices flagged.
Priya: Are those invoices VAT-registered customers? If EU B2B reverse-charge, surcharge shouldn't be taxed but it looks like VAT was applied.
Jules: Most are B2B with VAT IDs on file but the invoice lines show VAT on the surcharge. Example invoice:
```
Invoice #INV-2024-8723
Line 1: Usage charges $1,250.00
Line 2: Experimental surcharge A +$75.00
VAT 20%: $265.00
Total: $1,590.00
``` 
Marco: Yikes. That will cause overbilling of VAT. Do we reissue credit notes and reissue invoices without VAT on the surcharge? Or can we issue a single credit for the VAT portion? Need guidance.
Priya: For EU B2B with valid VAT ID, the surcharge is part of the taxable base only if it's a consideration for supply; but reverse-charge should apply to whole consideration. If we incorrectly charged and collected VAT, we should refund VAT to the customer and adjust our VAT return. Can do per-invoice credit notes.
Sasha: Is there a contract clause about experimental surcharges? Any gross-up or tax indemnity? If not, vendor/customer liability stays standard.
Jules: No indemnity. We need to: 1) identify impacted invoices, 2) create credit notes for VAT lines on surcharge, 3) reissue corrected invoices, 4) apply account credits or refunds.
Marco: I'll pull the list. Is Finance ok with doing partial refunds vs account credit? Some customers insist on refunds for accounting.
Priya: Prefer refunds for amounts > €100, credits otherwise. Also capture customer's VAT ID snapshot and include note referencing credit reason 'VAT overcharge - experimental surcharge'.
Jules: Can Legal OK the messaging template? Draft below:
"We issued an experimental surcharge in error; we have credited the VAT portion and reissued your invoice. Please contact billing@redwood.ai if you need a cash refund."
Sasha: Fine but add "No action required if you prefer account credit." Also add ticket link.
Jules: Thanks. Marco — can you deliver the list and suggested refund amounts by EOD?
Marco: On it, will upload CSV to /shared/finance/surcharge-reeval.csv and ping when ready :eyes: 
billing-bot: Automated note — 82 invoices flagged, total VAT to refund ~€3,780. Processing ETA 3 business days for credits.
Jules: Awesome. Priya, once we issue credits, will this affect MTD/VAT returns? Need to log in VAT adjustment schedule.
Priya: Yes — will submit adjustment in next period. I'll prep template entries. 
Jules: Cool. Marking as actioned once Marco uploads list. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
